boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Augustana University
boards.description: Verifiable late-night dining and ritual spots for Augustana University students in Sioux Falls, featuring campus traditions and local 24-hour staples.

cards.title: Moonlight Breakfast at Ordal
cards.subtitle: A finals week tradition in Morrison Commons
cards.notes: Attend the Semester Shutdown to enjoy free late-night breakfast served by faculty. This tradition includes bingo and trivia to help students de-stress before exams.
cards.short_summary: Ordal Dining Hall hosts the 'Moonlight Breakfast' during finals week, a signature campus event where faculty serve students late-night meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Augustana University's Semester Shutdown includes Moonlight Breakfast from 9-10:30 p.m. followed by bingo in the Ordal Dining Hall.
cards.access_notes: Open late specifically during Semester Shutdown events; typically 9:00 PM to 10:30 PM.

cards.title: 24-Hour Tacos on Minnesota Ave
cards.subtitle: Authentic Mexican food near campus
cards.notes: Visit this 24-hour staple for street tacos and burritos. It is a frequent destination for students seeking authentic late-night meals just a short drive from the dorms.
cards.short_summary: Giliberto's is a local 24-hour Mexican restaurant known for its extensive menu of tacos, burritos, and breakfast plates available at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Giliberto's Mexican Taco Shop at 712 S Minnesota Ave is open 24 hours a day and serves breakfast all day.
cards.source_title: Giliberto's Mexican Taco Shop - Experience Sioux Falls
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: The 24/7 Fryn' Pan Run
cards.subtitle: Classic diner food on W 41st St
cards.notes: Stop by for a late-night skillet or pie. This 24-hour diner is a reliable spot for study groups needing a change of scenery and a full kitchen menu after midnight.
cards.short_summary: Fryn' Pan is a regional 24-hour diner chain offering classic American comfort food, breakfast, and a soup and salad bar.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fryn' Pan Family Restaurant in Sioux Falls offers 24-hour dining and free wireless internet.
cards.source_title: Fryn' Pan Family Restaurant - Sioux Falls
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Evening Brews at Viking Grounds
cards.subtitle: Starbucks coffee in the Siverson Lounge
cards.notes: Grab a latte or pastry while studying in the Morrison Commons. This on-campus spot serves Starbucks products and provides a social atmosphere for evening work.
cards.short_summary: Viking Grounds is the primary on-campus coffee shop, located in the Morrison Commons and serving Starbucks coffee and pastries.
cards.evidence_claim: Viking Grounds in the Morrison Commons has regular hours until 7:00 PM on weekdays and weekends.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation - Augustana University Dining
cards.access_notes: Open until 7:00 PM daily during the regular semester.

cards.title: Late Snacks at the C-Store
cards.subtitle: On-campus convenience in Morrison Commons
cards.notes: Pick up grab-and-go snacks, beverages, or basic groceries using your Viking Bucks. It is the most convenient late-evening option for residents in the central campus area.
cards.short_summary: The Market Cstore is Augustana's on-campus convenience store, providing snacks and essentials for students until mid-evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Market Cstore is open until 8:00 PM daily during the regular academic semester.
cards.access_notes: Open until 8:00 PM daily during the regular semester.

cards.title: Pancheros Burrito Runs
cards.subtitle: Fresh-pressed tortillas on 41st St
cards.notes: Head to 41st Street for a burrito with fresh-pressed tortillas. It is a popular off-campus choice for students looking for a quick, substantial meal until 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: Pancheros Mexican Grill is a fast-casual restaurant known for its custom burritos and fresh-pressed tortillas, open late into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Pancheros Mexican Grill at 1503 W 41st St is open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Grocery Runs at Hy-Vee
cards.subtitle: Late-night essentials on Minnesota Ave
cards.notes: Visit the South Minnesota location for late-night grocery needs or a quick meal from the food court. It serves as a primary resource for off-campus and apartment residents.
cards.short_summary: Hy-Vee is a regional grocery chain with a location near campus that offers a wide selection of food and a pharmacy until 11 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sioux Falls #3 Hy-Vee at 3000 South Minnesota Avenue is open daily from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Casey's Pizza Night
cards.subtitle: Convenience and pizza on N Minnesota Ave
cards.notes: Order a signature pizza or grab quick snacks at this convenience store. It is a well-known regional spot for late-night food runs when other kitchens are closed.
cards.short_summary: Casey's is a convenience store chain famous for its pizza, offering delivery and pickup options until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Casey's at 1400 N Minnesota Ave is open until 11:00 PM daily, with kitchen services available for pickup and delivery.
cards.source_title: 1400 N Minnesota Ave - Pizza Delivery and Pickup in Sioux Falls, SD | Casey's
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Late Nights at Mikkelsen
cards.subtitle: The primary late-night study hub
cards.notes: Utilize the library's extended hours during finals week for deep study sessions. It offers a quiet environment and access to resources long after academic buildings close.
cards.short_summary: Mikkelsen Library is the main academic library at Augustana, offering extended hours and dedicated study spaces during the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Mikkelsen Library provides extended hours during the spring semester finals period, as noted on their official social media and campus updates.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by term; extended late-night hours are provided during finals week.

cards.title: Toppers Late-Night Delivery
cards.subtitle: Pizza and Topperstix until 3 AM
cards.notes: Order Topperstix for a late-night study group. This chain is a favorite for its 3 AM closing time and reliable delivery to campus dormitories.
cards.short_summary: Toppers Pizza is a delivery-focused chain known for its late-night availability and signature 'Topperstix' cheesy breadsticks.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers Pizza in Sioux Falls is documented by student media as serving food until 3 a.m., making it a staple for late-night runs.
cards.access_notes: Open for delivery and pickup until 3:00 AM daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional study nooks, quiet galleries, and late-night hubs that define daily life for Vikings at Augustana University.

cards.title: The Third Floor Stacks
cards.subtitle: Quiet study cubes hidden among the bookshelves
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for deep focus. Students utilize the individual study cubes tucked behind the stacks for long, uninterrupted sessions.
cards.short_summary: A quiet zone on the top floor of the library featuring individual study carrels for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: Students spend late nights in cubes hidden by the bookshelves on the third floor of the Mikkelsen Library.
cards.source_title: Reimagining campus spaces - The Augustana Mirror
cards.access_notes: Open late during the academic year; accessible to students and the public.

cards.title: The Huddle Snack Bar
cards.subtitle: Lower level social and dining hub
cards.notes: Grab a quick bite or meet for group projects in this lower-level snack bar located within the Morrison Commons.
cards.short_summary: A casual snack bar and meeting space located on the lower level of the Morrison Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The lower level of Morrison Commons includes 'The Huddle' snack bar and the Siverson Lounge.
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of the Commons; hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Froiland Study Alcoves
cards.subtitle: Glass-walled nooks for STEM students
cards.notes: Use the integrated study alcoves for quick review between labs. These spots offer natural light and views of the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: Modern study nooks and collaborative spaces integrated throughout the Froiland Science Complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Collaborative spaces are infused throughout with open meeting areas and study alcoves in the Froiland Science Complex.
cards.source_title: Augustana University - Froiland Science Complex - SmithGroup
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; popular for science majors between classes.

cards.title: Eide/Dalrymple Gallery
cards.subtitle: Quiet art space in the Center for Visual Arts
cards.notes: Visit the gallery to see rotating student and professional exhibits. It is a peaceful place for a creative break between classes.
cards.short_summary: The primary art gallery on campus, showcasing student work and the Carl Grupp Permanent Collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eide/Dalrymple Gallery provides a space for showcasing an average of nine exhibits per year and is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Art Galleries and Exhibits - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Free admission; located within the Center for Visual Arts.

cards.title: Madsen Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Room 152 in the Madsen Social Science Center
cards.notes: Commuter students use this dedicated lounge in the Madsen Center for studying and resting between social science lectures.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge space for commuter students located on the first floor of the Madsen Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Madsen Center Room 152 is designated as the Commuter Student Lounge.
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 152; primarily serves commuter students.

cards.title: Wagoner Student Street
cards.subtitle: Glass-enclosed walkway connecting campus hubs
cards.notes: Walk through this glass-enclosed corridor to get from the Commons to the Mortenson Center without going outside.
cards.short_summary: A glass-enclosed indoor walkway that connects the Morrison Commons and the Edith Mortenson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Edith Mortenson Center is connected to the Morrison Commons by the glass-enclosed Wagoner Student Street.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours for Morrison Commons and Mortenson Center.

cards.title: The Elmen Pool
cards.subtitle: 25-yard indoor pool for student recreation
cards.notes: Take a break from studying with a swim. The 25-yard pool is available for student use during designated open swim hours.
cards.short_summary: A 25-yard indoor swimming pool located within the Elmen Center for athletic and recreational use.
cards.evidence_claim: Augustana students may take advantage of a 25-yard swimming pool in the Elmen Center.
cards.access_notes: Access included with student ID; check Rec Services for open swim times.

cards.title: CWS Fantle Building Gallery
cards.subtitle: Free museum and research space
cards.notes: Explore the history of the Northern Plains in the Fantle Building. The galleries are free and offer a quiet, scholarly atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A research center and gallery dedicated to the American West, located on the south side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Center for Western Studies' art and museum galleries is free.
cards.source_title: CWS Frequently Asked Questions - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. - 5 p.m.

cards.title: The Library Booths
cards.subtitle: Semi-private group study spots
cards.notes: Grab a booth on the main floor for collaborative projects. These spots offer a balance of comfort and table space for laptops.
cards.short_summary: Comfortable, semi-private booths located in the Mikkelsen Library for group or individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Mikkelsen Library offers various study spaces including booths, study rooms, and standing desks.
cards.access_notes: Available on a first-come, first-served basis during library hours.

cards.title: The Outdoor Classroom
cards.subtitle: Open-air learning space near Froiland
cards.notes: When the weather is nice, students gather at the outdoor classroom for fresh-air study sessions or informal club meetings.
cards.short_summary: A designated outdoor space on the Campus Green used for classes and student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus map identifies an 'Outdoor Classroom' (Building 9) located near the Froiland Science Complex.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; weather dependent.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing

cards.title: Browse the Eide/Dalrymple Gallery
cards.subtitle: Center for Visual Arts
cards.notes: View rotating exhibits and the Carl Grupp Permanent Collection. Admission is free for students and the public during gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art gallery featuring professional and student exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery is open to the public and handicapped accessible; admission is free.

cards.title: Visit the Center for Western Studies
cards.subtitle: Fantle Building
cards.notes: Explore Northern Plains history through free museum galleries and archives. No admission fee is required for visitors.

cards.source_title: CWS Frequently Asked Questions - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Museum and galleries are open Monday-Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Study at Mikkelsen Library
cards.subtitle: Campus Academic Hub

cards.title: Attend UBG Friday Night Events

cards.title: Relax at the Outdoor Classroom

cards.title: Work Out at the Elmen Center

cards.evidence_claim: With an Augustana ID, you can use the weight room, pool or check out recreational equipment... at no cost.

cards.title: Walk Through the Augustana Garden
cards.subtitle: West 28th Street
cards.notes: Visit the student-run community garden to learn about sustainable food production. The space is open for students to interact and relax.

cards.evidence_claim: The garden provides an outdoor classroom for groups of students and community members to learn, interact or relax.

cards.title: Hear the Augustana Bach Collegium

cards.notes: Attend free public concerts of Bach's sacred works performed by university ensembles at the nearby partner church.
cards.short_summary: Free classical music performances hosted in collaboration with a local church.
cards.evidence_claim: The Augustana Bach Collegium will perform its fall and spring events at OSL... free and available to the public.

cards.access_notes: Check the School of Music calendar for specific performance dates.

cards.title: Hang Out in Morrison Commons
cards.subtitle: Student Union
cards.notes: Relax in the renovated 'pockets' of social space or the Back Alley. These areas are free for students to gather and socialize.

cards.evidence_claim: The plan includes creating 'pockets' of smaller meeting spaces... designed to give students an alcohol-free environment.
cards.source_title: Augustana University Begins Phase II of Renovations to Morrison Commons

cards.title: Watch Free Viking Athletics

cards.notes: Attend home events for cross country, golf, swimming, tennis, and track & field for free. No ticket purchase is required for these sports.
cards.short_summary: Select Augustana University athletic competitions that are open to the public at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: The following sports are free and open to the public for all home events: Cross Country, Golf, Swimming, Tennis, and Track & Field.
cards.source_title: Tickets for Gift Codes | vivenu - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Check GoAugie.com for the current season schedule of free events.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique customs of Augustana University, from Scandinavian-inspired royalty to the legendary spirit of Ole the Viking.

cards.title: The Crowning of Royalty
cards.subtitle: A Century-Old Homecoming Tradition
cards.notes: Attend the official crowning of the Viking Days King and Queen in the Elmen Center, a tradition dating back to the first homecoming in 1924.
cards.short_summary: The central ceremony of homecoming week where student royalty is crowned.
cards.evidence_claim: Coronation is one of Augustana's longest-standing traditions, dating back to the first celebration in the early 1920s and held in the Elmen Center.
cards.access_notes: Held annually during Viking Days (homecoming) week in the Elmen Center.

cards.title: The Royal Knitwear
cards.subtitle: Scandinavian Heritage on Display
cards.notes: Watch for Viking Days royalty candidates wearing traditional Norwegian sweaters, a unique nod to the university's Lutheran Scandinavian roots.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming royalty candidates wear traditional Norwegian sweaters instead of formal attire.
cards.evidence_claim: Students nominated for Viking Days king and queen don Norwegian sweaters, a tradition reflecting the school's Scandinavian heritage.
cards.source_title: A Beardless Hobo & Other Homecoming Traditions
cards.access_notes: Visible during Viking Days parade and coronation events.

cards.title: The Spirit of Ole
cards.subtitle: Guardian of the Campus Green
cards.notes: Visit the concrete statue of Ole, designed by Peter Eide '66, which has stood guard over the campus quad since its dedication in 1967.
cards.short_summary: A landmark statue representing the university's mascot and Scandinavian identity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ole the Viking statue was designed by Peter Eide '66 and has kept watch over the Augustana campus since 1967.
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors between the Administration Building and Morrison Commons; accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Viking Varieties Show
cards.subtitle: Student Talent Extravaganza
cards.notes: Experience one of AU's most beloved traditions, a student-led variety show featuring music, dance, and comedy during homecoming week.
cards.short_summary: A long-running talent show that serves as a highlight of the Viking Days celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Viking Varieties is one of Augustana's most beloved homecoming traditions, with its first show held in the gym.
cards.access_notes: Performances typically held in the Elmen Center during Viking Days.

cards.title: Christmas Vespers
cards.subtitle: A Sermon in Song
cards.notes: Join the community for this 80+ year tradition of music and word, featuring the Augustana Choir and multiple instrumental ensembles.
cards.short_summary: An annual holiday concert series that has been a campus staple since 1938.
cards.evidence_claim: The first Christmas Vespers service at Augustana was created in 1938 and has continued as an annual highlight.
cards.access_notes: Currently held at Gloria Dei Lutheran Church in Sioux Falls during early December.

cards.title: Festival of Sankta Lucia
cards.subtitle: Swedish Celebration of Light
cards.notes: Celebrate the Swedish 'Festival of Light' with a candlelit procession and traditional carols led by a student portraying Sankta Lucia.
cards.short_summary: A traditional Swedish holiday event honoring the university's cultural heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: The Festival of Sankta Lucia is a cherished holiday tradition that pays homage to the college's Swedish cultural heritage.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early December, typically in the Chapel of Reconciliation.

cards.title: The Boe Forum
cards.subtitle: Global Voices in Sioux Falls
cards.notes: Attend this premier lecture series that has hosted world leaders like Mikhail Gorbachev and Condoleezza Rice since its inception in 1995.
cards.short_summary: A prestigious annual forum bringing global figures to campus for public discourse.
cards.evidence_claim: In 1995, the Center for Western Studies introduced the Boe Forum on Public Affairs, hosting many of the world's most influential leaders.
cards.source_title: Boe Forum on Public Affairs - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the Elmen Center; tickets are required but often free to the public.

cards.title: Sailing Into Service
cards.subtitle: Homecoming Community Impact
cards.notes: Participate in this Viking Days volunteer event where students create items for local charities, such as handmade toys for animal shelters.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated day of community service integrated into the homecoming week festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: Sailing Into Service is a Viking Days tradition where students give back to the community through various service projects.
cards.access_notes: Held on the Tuesday of Viking Days week, usually in the Morrison Commons.

cards.title: Augustana Twilight
cards.subtitle: Racing Under the Lights
cards.notes: Join thousands of fans for this massive night-time cross country race at Yankton Trail Park, featuring high school and collegiate divisions.
cards.short_summary: One of the largest night-time cross country meets in the region, hosted by AU.
cards.evidence_claim: The Augustana Twilight is one of the largest races in the region, attracting more than 5,000 participants and fans for races under the lights.
cards.source_title: Twelfth Annual Augustana Twilight Set for Sept. 1
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early September at Yankton Trail Park.

cards.title: The Viking Feast
cards.subtitle: A Community Meal with the Augie Bowl
cards.notes: Enjoy a community meal during Viking Days featuring the 'Augie Bowl' and live music from the Augustana Jazz Band.
cards.short_summary: A traditional homecoming meal that brings together students, staff, and retirees.
cards.evidence_claim: The Viking Feast is a long-held Viking Days tradition of enjoying a meal together, complete with the Augie Bowl.
cards.access_notes: Held on the Wednesday evening of Viking Days in the Elmen Center.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Augustana University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide to your first few days as a Viking, featuring essential campus landmarks, orientation traditions, and student hubs in Sioux Falls.

cards.title: Kick Off Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: Check-in and Resource Fair
cards.notes: Start your weekend by picking up your orientation folder and meeting student leaders in the heart of campus student life.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for Welcome Week check-in and initial student orientation activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Week check-in and the Resource Fair are held at the Morrison Commons (formerly Gerber Center) to provide students with schedules and resources.
cards.access_notes: Open during scheduled orientation hours; typically starts Friday morning of move-in weekend.

cards.title: Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: The Official Welcome
cards.notes: Join the university president and your entire incoming class for the formal academic induction ceremony on the field.
cards.short_summary: The formal ceremony welcoming new students and their families to the Augustana community.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation is held at the football stadium where the President addresses incoming students for the first time.
cards.access_notes: Required for new students; seating is provided in the home side bleachers.

cards.title: The Short Goodbye
cards.subtitle: Transition to Campus Life
cards.notes: A brief, symbolic moment at the stadium where students bid farewell to families and join their peer groups.
cards.short_summary: A tradition marking the transition from family-led move-in to student-led orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Short Goodbye' occurs at the stadium immediately following Convocation, marking the end of parent participation in Welcome Week.
cards.access_notes: Takes place on Friday afternoon of Welcome Week.

cards.title: Explore the Library
cards.subtitle: Academic Resource Hub
cards.notes: Visit the library to find your favorite study nook or check out the 24/7 study space for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary academic library offering diverse study zones and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Mikkelsen Library provides various study environments, including quiet floors and a 24/7 study space accessible via the south entrance.
cards.access_notes: 24/7 study space is available for students with ID card access during the academic year.

cards.title: Get Active at Elmen
cards.subtitle: Recreation and Fitness
cards.notes: Check out the swimming pool, racquetball courts, or join a group fitness class to stay active between orientation events.
cards.short_summary: The main campus recreation facility featuring a pool, courts, and fitness equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elmen Center serves as the core facility for campus recreational sports, offering a pool, racquetball courts, and fitness classes.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check the recreational services website for specific pool and gym hours.

cards.title: Discover Regional History
cards.subtitle: Art and Museum Galleries
cards.notes: Walk through the free galleries to see art and artifacts documenting the history of the Northern Plains.
cards.short_summary: A research agency and museum on campus dedicated to the history and cultures of the American West.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Center for Western Studies' art and museum galleries is free for students and the public.
cards.source_title: Center for Western Studies - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Sunday Morning Worship
cards.subtitle: Spiritual Life on Campus
cards.notes: Attend a service in the renovated sanctuary to experience the university's Lutheran heritage and musical traditions.
cards.short_summary: The campus chapel hosting regular worship services and spiritual life programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel of Reconciliation hosts regular worship services, including Monday, Wednesday, and Friday morning sessions.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled services and personal reflection; check the online schedule for specific times.

cards.title: View Student Art
cards.subtitle: Center for Visual Arts
cards.notes: Browse rotating exhibitions featuring professional artists and Augustana student work in the Fryxell Humanities Center.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary art gallery showcasing a permanent collection and temporary exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eide/Dalrymple Gallery, located in the Center for Visual Arts, hosts approximately nine exhibits per year and is free to visit.
cards.source_title: Art Galleries and Exhibits - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Saturday 1 p.m. to 4 p.m.

cards.title: Relax by the Slough
cards.subtitle: Campus Natural Landmark
cards.notes: Take a walk along the path surrounding this iconic campus water feature, perfect for a quiet break or a quick photo.
cards.short_summary: A scenic body of water on campus known for its seasonal foliage and resident wildlife.
cards.evidence_claim: The slough is a recognized campus landmark with a walking path and is noted as a popular spot for photography and relaxation.
cards.source_title: 7 most Instagrammable places on campus - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Viking Days Kick-Off
cards.subtitle: Homecoming Tradition
cards.notes: While later in the fall, visit the Green to see where the university's biggest traditions begin with community celebrations.
cards.short_summary: The central lawn used for major campus events, including the start of Viking Days festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: Viking Days, the university's homecoming, traditionally kicks off with events on the Campus Green.
cards.access_notes: Central outdoor space; major events are scheduled throughout the academic year.
